title: wg: room-policy-04 §10.2 ranges overlap at 0xF000
description: draft-ietf-mimi-room-policy-04 §10.2 gives Specification Required as 0x0000 to 0xF000 and Private Use as 0xF000 to 0xFFFF; 0xF000 is in both. mimid treats it as Private Use (decision P-cap1). Report to the MIMI WG.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED: 0xF000 in both ranges; use 0x0000-0xEFFF. Editorial PR.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-room-policy/pull/39
